required_premises: Execution history; continuity-relevant evidence; reconstruction history; remediation history; classification basis.
counterexample_condition: Broken continuity is later classified preserved solely because function or balances were restored.
evidence_requirement: Continuity classification record; complete relevant execution/remediation history; evidence supporting preserved/broken/indeterminate status.
implementation_requirement: Reference runtime must expose explicit continuity classification.
verification_requirement: Broken/restored/reconstructed/indeterminate continuity cases.

formal_target: Show that distributed consensus, ledger validity, or one participant's authority cannot independently establish whole-chain governance authority.

implementation_requirement: Distributed adapters must preserve authority/admission separation from consensus/ledger validity.
verification_requirement: Consensus-without-authority, multi-party authority conflict, remote-state drift cases.

obligation_name: Agent Capability Is Not Economic Authority
formal_target: Show that autonomous financial execution remains bound to valid external authority, principal resolution, delegation attenuation, and current admitted intent.
required_premises: Agent identity; principal reference; delegation chain; authorized intent; current action; scope; current authority.
counterexample_condition: An agent executes outside valid principal/delegation/scope/current-intent authority or self-authorizes.
evidence_requirement: Principal binding; delegation chain; agent identity; intent binding; current action; admission decision.
implementation_requirement: Agent execution must resolve principal, delegation, current intent, scope, and admission.
verification_requirement: Self-authorization, scope drift, principal loss, delegation attenuation, intent drift cases.
